title: DEP-SEC-001B: Post-#253 residual consolidation and PR fan-out control
intent: After PR #253 (Tier-1 COMPLETE) created Dependabot intake, five version-update PRs (#254-#258) opened within minutes. This sprint inventories those PRs, builds an authoritative DEP-SEC-001 residual disposition matrix, syncs MAINT-DEFER-004 parent state (ACTIVE — TIER 1 COMPLETE, not program RESOLVED), clarifies Tier-1 closeout ≠ parent closeout, adds Residual Obligations Check (Rule 8) to docs/SPRINTS_MAINTENANCE.md, and closes #254-#258 with durable disposition comments deferring work to at most two future tranches (B residual/hygiene, C vitest→vite). No dependency or production code mutation.
behavior_change: none - governance and documentation only. No package, lockfile, Python requirements, Dependabot config, or production source changes.

diff_articulation.what_changed: (1) Created docs/ci/DEP_SEC_001_RESIDUAL_DISPOSITION_2026-08-10.md — parent residual matrix inventorying #254-#258, #252/#253 relationships, dispositions, Tranche B/C grouping, closure conditions, Residual Obligations Check. (2) SPRINTS.md MAINT-DEFER-004 updated to DEP-SEC-001 parent ACTIVE — TIER 1 COMPLETE with generated-PR disposition table. (3) Tier-1 closeout clarified as tranche-only; §9 residual pointer added. (4) docs/SPRINTS_MAINTENANCE.md Rule 8 Residual Obligations Check + anti-pattern 8. GitHub: closed #254-#258 with disposition comments (external to git). (5) Historical-boundary clarification: inherited residuals (archive dismissals, alert recalc, npm audit residual, Python requirements-dev, Vite/Vitest, BR-021) are accounted in the matrix as INHERITED — not newly discovered defects caused by #253; fan-out trigger remains PRs #254–#258; added R-10 for npm audit residual surface.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Repairs the post-#253 fan-out failure mode: residuals and automation PRs existed without a single parent-program disposition boundary. Does not re-implement Tier-1 or bump dependencies.

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Docs/governance only. Closing Dependabot version PRs retains obligations in the residual matrix. No dependabot.yml suppression, no dependency mutation, no alert dismissal. Post-review-fix status: the alert ledger was successfully read with owner credentials (the prior 403 was agent-environment-scoped), so the Tier-1 patch is now witnessed effective (65 -> 32 open; axios/postcss -> 0) and R-02 is discharged in-document. Two obligations are deliberately left open and are NOT closed here: R-01 archive-alert dismissal plus the dependabot.yml path exclusion that would stop regeneration, and R-11, the structural inability of Dependabot-authored PRs to pass api-verify, which constrains how Tranche B may ship.
